summary: A timeout while waiting for become privilege escalation is now an unreachable error rather than a task error, so use ignore_unreachable instead of ignore_errors to tolerate it.
questions: Why doesn't ignore_errors catch become timeouts anymore?
How do I ignore a privilege escalation timeout in ansible-core 2.19?
Is a become timeout a failed task or an unreachable host?

answer_card.title: Become timeouts are now unreachable errors
answer_card.answer_md: In ansible-core 2.19, a timeout waiting on privilege escalation (`become`) marks the host **unreachable** instead of failing the task. On tasks where you want to tolerate this, replace `ignore_errors` with `ignore_unreachable`.
